boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of California-Davis, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A daylight-friendly campus loop built around public art, gardens, and a free museum visit.

cards.title: Start at the Memorial Union
cards.subtitle: First stop: get oriented at a campus hub
cards.notes: Begin at the MU to locate student-facing services, study lounges, the Coffee House, Games Area, and the Information Desk before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A central starting point for navigating campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis identifies the Memorial Union as a central student-life hub with student services, study lounges, the Coffee House, and Games Area.
cards.access_notes: Check the Memorial Union's current hours before arriving; individual services and venues may keep different schedules.

cards.title: Find Bookhead by Shields Library
cards.subtitle: Second stop: begin an Egghead art walk
cards.notes: Walk to the light-blue Bookhead in front of Shields Library, scan its informational label, and use the campus art map to continue the route.
cards.short_summary: The first installed Egghead anchors a self-guided public-art stop.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis lists Bookhead in front of Peter J. Shields Library as the first Egghead sculpture, installed in October 1991.
cards.source_title: UC Davis Honors Its Iconic Eggheads and Arts Heritage
cards.access_notes: The university's self-guided Egghead Art Walk is listed from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.; stay on public paths.

cards.title: Spot Eye on Mrak
cards.subtitle: Third stop: public art beside administration
cards.notes: Continue to the north side of Mrak Hall and look up at Eye on Mrak (Fatal Laff); read the label for the sculpture's campus context.
cards.short_summary: An upside-down Egghead at a documented central-campus location.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis locates Eye on Mrak (Fatal Laff) on the north side of Mrak Hall and lists it among the five Egghead sites.
cards.source_title: UC Davis Honors Its Iconic Eggheads and Arts Heritage
cards.access_notes: The university's self-guided Egghead Art Walk is listed from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.; stay on public paths.

cards.title: Pause at Yin & Yang
cards.subtitle: Fourth stop: two sculptures outside Wright Hall
cards.notes: Head to Wright Hall's front lawn to view Yin & Yang together, then compare their paired forms before moving toward the next art location.
cards.short_summary: A paired Egghead installation on the arts-side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis locates Yin & Yang in front of Wright Hall and states it was installed in September 1992.
cards.source_title: UC Davis Honors Its Iconic Eggheads and Arts Heritage
cards.access_notes: The university's self-guided Egghead Art Walk is listed from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.; stay on public paths.

cards.title: Track down Stargazer
cards.subtitle: Fifth stop: finish the central Egghead set
cards.notes: Find Stargazer east of North Hall and south of Young Hall, using the interactive art map rather than cutting through planted areas.
cards.short_summary: A named Egghead positioned between North and Young Halls.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis locates Stargazer east of North Hall and south of Young Hall, with installation in May 1994.
cards.source_title: UC Davis Honors Its Iconic Eggheads and Arts Heritage
cards.access_notes: The university's self-guided Egghead Art Walk is listed from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.; stay on public paths.

cards.title: Reach See No Evil/Hear No Evil
cards.subtitle: Sixth stop: a paired sculpture by King Hall
cards.notes: Make the final Egghead stop at the traffic circle across from King Hall; use the posted information to connect it with the wider series.
cards.short_summary: A two-part public artwork at the King Hall traffic circle.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis locates See No Evil/Hear No Evil in the traffic circle across from the School of Law's King Hall.
cards.source_title: UC Davis Honors Its Iconic Eggheads and Arts Heritage
cards.access_notes: The university's self-guided Egghead Art Walk is listed from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m.; use marked crossings around the traffic circle.

cards.entity_name: Jan Shrem and Maria Manetti Shrem Museum of Art
cards.title: Step into the Manetti Shrem Museum
cards.subtitle: Seventh stop: a free indoor art reset
cards.notes: Visit the galleries and check the exhibition information on arrival; plan parking separately if driving, since campus visitor parking can require payment.
cards.short_summary: A campus art museum with free admission for all visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Manetti Shrem Museum's Winter 2026 release states that visitor admission is free for all.
cards.source_title: Manetti Shrem Museum Winter 2026 Press Release
cards.access_notes: Museum admission is free; visitor parking may cost money on weekdays. Confirm gallery hours and exhibitions before visiting.

cards.title: Enter through Arboretum GATEway Garden
cards.subtitle: Eighth stop: begin the east-side garden loop
cards.notes: Use the Arboretum visitor map to start the orange loop at GATEway Garden, then follow the route at a comfortable pace beside campus landscapes.
cards.short_summary: A documented starting point for the Arboretum's east-side loop.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis identifies Arboretum GATEway Garden as the starting point for the east-side orange loop.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Arboretum and Public Garden locations are free and open every day; follow posted landscape and wildlife guidance.

cards.title: Take a quiet loop through the Oak Grove
cards.subtitle: Ninth stop: slow down beneath the oaks
cards.notes: Walk the open lawns and identify a few oak types from the interpretive information; keep to established paths and leave the collection undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: An Arboretum collection with more than 80 types of oaks.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis states that more than 80 kinds of oaks are found in the Peter J. Shields Oak Grove.
cards.source_title: UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden Interpretive Exhibits
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Arboretum and Public Garden locations are free and open every day; follow posted landscape and wildlife guidance.

cards.title: End at the Good Life Garden
cards.subtitle: Tenth stop: explore an edible demonstration garden
cards.notes: Finish by viewing the raised beds, pollinator-friendly plantings, signage, and outdoor seating in the Robert Mondavi Institute courtyard.
cards.short_summary: A student-tended edible landscape and outdoor learning site.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis describes the Good Life Garden as an ornamental edible demonstration garden with student-designed raised beds and pollinator-friendly plantings.
cards.source_title: Good Life Garden | UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Arboretum and Public Garden locations are free and open every day; respect raised beds, signs, and any event setup.
